sun.aries: You tend to show up as someone who starts things and is seen starting them. Directness, courage, and a clear first move are what people read in you, and your sense of self is at its brightest in action.
sun.taurus: You tend to be recognised by steadiness: what you build, keep, and return to. Identity gathers around the senses, comfort, and a pace that does not bend easily to other people's hurry.
sun.gemini: Your sense of self tends to live in curiosity, conversation, and the quick exchange of ideas. You are read as many-sided, drawn to learning something new each day and passing it along.
sun.cancer: You tend to define yourself through belonging: family, home, and the people you feed and protect. Feeling comes first and shows in your mood, and you remember how a room felt long after.
sun.leo: You are at home in the centre of things, and warmth, generosity, and a visible creative presence come naturally. People tend to notice you arriving, and you tend to notice whether they feel welcome.
sun.virgo: You tend to find identity in usefulness, noticing what needs mending and quietly mending it. Precision and service draw you, and your standards for your own work run higher than anyone else's.
sun.libra: Identity tends to form through relationship, and you may weigh other people's preferences heavily before finding your own. The gift is real fairness; the work is learning to say what you want first.
sun.scorpio: You tend to be drawn beneath surfaces, toward what people hide and what they cannot say aloud. Intensity and privacy go together, and your sense of self was shaped by loyalty and what you have come through.
sun.sagittarius: You tend to orient toward meaning, distance, and the larger picture. Travel, belief, and plain honesty draw you, and people read you as restless for the next horizon and generous with what you find there.
sun.capricorn: You tend to show up as the one who carries responsibility and plays the long game. Ambition is practical, authority is earned over time, and you are read as dependable once the work is underway.
sun.aquarius: You tend to stand slightly apart from the group, which gives you a clear view of it. Shining personally works against the grain, so you speak through principles, causes, and friendships, and self-display takes deliberate effort.
sun.pisces: You tend to take in the mood around you, and your sense of self is porous, imaginative, and compassionate. Art, faith, or quiet retreat draws you, and the line between you and others needs tending.

moon.aries: Your feelings tend to arrive fast and plain: anger, enthusiasm, impatience, then relief once you have acted on them. You settle by doing something, and you are read as direct about what you need.
moon.taurus: Your emotional life tends to settle into steadiness, and you feel best when the body is fed, rested, and comfortable. Familiar routines and pleasant surroundings steady you, and you are slow to be rattled.
moon.gemini: You tend to process feeling by talking it through, naming it, and looking at it from another angle. Your moods shift quickly, and you settle when someone is curious with you.
moon.cancer: You feel deeply and tend to protect those you love with an instinct that needs no instruction. Memory, home, and food carry emotional weight for you, and you read the mood of a room immediately.
moon.leo: You tend to need warmth, appreciation, and a place where your feelings can be expressed with some colour. Your loyalty is generous and proud, and being overlooked hurts more than you usually admit.
moon.virgo: You tend to manage feeling by being useful, sorting, fixing, and keeping things in order. Worry can run quietly in the background, and your care shows in practical detail rather than speeches.
moon.libra: You tend to feel steadier when the people around you are at peace, and conflict unsettles you more than you let on. Your feelings are often discovered through how others react to them.
moon.scorpio: Your feelings tend to run deep and stay private, and trust has to be built before you show them. Safety comes from loyalty that has been tested, and you have to earn your own emotional footing.
moon.sagittarius: You tend to feel better with room to move, with honest talk, and with something ahead to look forward to. Optimism is your habit of recovery, and confinement of any kind wears on you.
moon.capricorn: Your feelings tend to be held in check, and warmth shows through reliability more than through words. Showing need goes against the grain, but you stay composed and dependable when others cannot.
moon.aquarius: You tend to step back from feeling in order to see it, and you steady yourself through friends, ideas, and perspective. Closeness is welcome on your own terms, and you need air as well.
moon.pisces: You tend to absorb the feelings around you as if they were your own, which makes you tender, intuitive, and easily tired by crowds. Music, water, and solitude help you find your edges again.

mercury.aries: Your mind tends to move fast and speak first, with opinions formed on the spot and stated without padding. You are read as blunt and quick, and you often think best while arguing or acting.
mercury.taurus: You tend to think slowly and thoroughly, preferring what can be tested and used. Once you form a view it holds firm, and your speech is unhurried and practical.
mercury.gemini: Your mind is at home here, quick, curious, and fluent. You tend to collect information, connect unlikely things, and enjoy a good exchange, and you can usually see more than one version of the story.
mercury.cancer: Your thinking tends to run through memory and mood, so you recall how things were said as clearly as what was said. You learn best when you feel safe, and you speak with feeling.
mercury.leo: You tend to talk with confidence and a sense of occasion, and people listen when you tell a story. You like your ideas to be noticed, and you think with a touch of showmanship.
mercury.virgo: Your mind is at home and at its best here, analytical, exact, and watchful for what is out of place. You tend to sort, refine, and improve, and your clarity is a practical gift.
mercury.libra: You tend to weigh both sides before speaking and to choose words with an ear for tact and balance. Deciding can take a while, but your judgment is fair and your phrasing gracious.
mercury.scorpio: You tend to probe for what lies under the stated reason, and you notice what is left unsaid. Your mind is focused and private, and you speak sparingly but pointedly.
mercury.sagittarius: Your mind reaches for the big picture and works against the grain of small detail. You tend to think in principles and possibilities, speak frankly, and teach well, though fine print needs extra care.
mercury.capricorn: You tend to think in plans, structures, and consequences, and your speech is measured and dry. Ideas ripen slowly with you, and what you finally say tends to have been thought through.
mercury.aquarius: Your mind tends to work in systems and patterns, and it reaches for unconventional answers. You are read as original and a little detached, more interested in how things work than in how they feel.
mercury.pisces: You tend to think in images and impressions before arguments, which makes you imaginative and quick to sense what is unspoken. Linear logic has to be built deliberately, and details can slip away.

venus.aries: You tend to pursue what you want openly and without delay, and attraction is quick and direct. Patience in courtship works against the grain, but your honesty and boldness make affection unmistakable.
venus.taurus: Your affections are at home here, sensual, loyal, and unhurried. You tend to value good food, touch, beauty, and things that last, and you stay with what you love.
venus.gemini: You tend to show affection through conversation, play, and curiosity about the other person. Variety keeps you engaged, and a lively mind is attractive to you before anything else.
venus.cancer: You tend to love by caring for people, remembering what they like, and making a place that feels safe. Affection runs warm and a little guarded, and you want to be needed.
venus.leo: You tend to love generously and in colour, with gestures, loyalty, and a wish to adore and be adored. Warmth comes easily, and you appreciate being appreciated back.
venus.virgo: You tend to show love through attention to practical detail, and you notice small things others miss. Accepting affection at face value takes time, so your devotion is earned and then lasting.
venus.libra: Your affections are at home here, graceful, fair-minded, and drawn to partnership and beauty. You tend to make things pleasant, value harmony, and have a refined eye for people and surroundings.
venus.scorpio: You tend to love with intensity and all-or-nothing commitment, and casual affection works against the grain. Loyalty runs deep, jealousy can follow, and trust is the thing you are really after.
venus.sagittarius: You tend to want a partner who shares adventure, honesty, and a bigger view of life. Freedom matters in love, and you are drawn to people who widen your world.
venus.capricorn: You tend to be slow to warm and serious in affection, preferring commitments that last. Love is shown through steadiness and effort, and you value respect and shared goals.
venus.aquarius: You tend to want friendship at the root of love, with room to be yourself. Affection is shown through loyalty to the person and curiosity about their ideas, and convention holds little appeal.
venus.pisces: Your affections are honored here, tender, romantic, and compassionate. You tend to love without keeping score, forgive readily, and respond to art, music, and anyone's quiet suffering.

mars.aries: Your drive is at home here, direct, quick, and unapologetic. You tend to start things at once, meet challenges head on, and recover from conflict faster than most.
mars.taurus: You tend to start slowly and stop reluctantly. Speed works against the grain, but once moving you have endurance, and your stubbornness can turn into remarkable persistence.
mars.gemini: You tend to act through words, argument, and juggling several tasks at once. Your drive is nimble and changeable, and you win by being quicker to see the angle.
mars.cancer: You tend to go around rather than straight at a fight, and anger often shows as moodiness or withdrawal. Acting for yourself takes some practice, but you become fierce for people you protect.
mars.leo: You tend to act with pride and flair, and effort matters more to you when it is seen. You are loyal in a fight, committed to what you start, and quick to feel disrespect.
mars.virgo: You tend to channel drive into work, precision, and improving how things are done. Anger shows up as criticism, and you are at your best when there is a concrete task to master.
mars.libra: Open conflict works against your grain, so you tend to negotiate, delay, or look for the fair settlement. The gift is strategy and a keen sense of timing, though direct action may need a push.
mars.scorpio: Your drive is at home here, focused, strategic, and patient enough to wait. You tend to commit everything to what matters, hold back what you intend, and keep going when others quit.
mars.sagittarius: You tend to act with enthusiasm, competitiveness, and a love of the chase. Your drive is energised by causes and open space, and it can run ahead of the plan.
mars.capricorn: Your drive is honored here, disciplined, ambitious, and willing to work for years. You tend to plan the campaign, conserve effort, and keep going when it gets hard.
mars.aquarius: You tend to act for ideas, groups, and causes more than for personal victory. Your drive is cool and unconventional, and you often work best on your own terms.
mars.pisces: Your drive tends to move by inspiration and sympathy, with a soft edge that avoids direct confrontation. Effort comes in waves, and you act most strongly on behalf of someone else.

jupiter.aries: You tend to grow by taking the first step and trusting your own initiative. Optimism is bold and a little impatient, and you are drawn to pioneering and to leading.
jupiter.taurus: You tend to grow through patient accumulation, enjoying comforts and building lasting value. Generosity shows up as hospitality, good food, and a steady willingness to share what you have.
jupiter.gemini: Your breadth of curiosity is wide, though settling on one conviction works against the grain. You tend to collect ideas and viewpoints, and the gift is a mind that can speak many languages.
jupiter.cancer: Your good fortune is honored here, expressed as generosity toward family, hospitality, and a protective wisdom. You tend to grow through caring, and your kindness is felt as shelter.
jupiter.leo: You tend to be expansive, big-hearted, and fond of ceremony and celebration. Confidence draws people to you, and your generosity is most real when you take pleasure in their success.
jupiter.virgo: Large visions have to be fitted into small, careful steps here, which works against the grain of expansion. You tend to grow through service, craft, and attention to what is useful.
jupiter.libra: You tend to grow through partnership, fairness, and a feel for what is just. Social ease is a resource for you, and you are drawn to diplomacy, law, and shared enterprise.
jupiter.scorpio: You tend to grow through depth, finding meaning in research, crisis, and shared resources. Faith for you is earned by looking at what is hard, and your generosity is quiet.
jupiter.sagittarius: Your faith and curiosity are at home here, drawn to teaching, travel, and big questions. You tend to trust that things work out, and your enthusiasm is easy and infectious.
jupiter.capricorn: Optimism has to be earned through structure, which makes it quieter here. You tend to grow by working within institutions and plans, and your hope, once built, has a sturdy foundation.
jupiter.aquarius: You tend to think expansively about community, reform, and what people could build together. Your generosity is impersonal and wide, and you are drawn to new ideas and networks.
jupiter.pisces: Your faith and compassion are at home here, wide, imaginative, and forgiving. You tend to trust the unseen, give without counting, and find meaning through art, belief, or service.

saturn.aries: You tend to doubt your own first move, and initiative has to build its own footing. Caution is the early habit; hard-won self-reliance and the nerve to act alone are the result.
saturn.taurus: You tend to build security slowly and carefully, and you distrust anything that comes too easily. Patience is your discipline, and resistance to change is both your strength and your risk.
saturn.gemini: You tend to take thought seriously, studying carefully and speaking only when sure. Mental discipline is your craft, and learning to trust a casual idea is part of the work.
saturn.cancer: Closeness and duty tend to be intertwined here, and asking for care works against your grain. You may carry family responsibility early, and the gift is a deep, reliable tenderness.
saturn.leo: Showing yourself openly works against the grain, and you may hold back for fear of being judged. The gift is earned confidence, and what you finally create has weight.
saturn.virgo: You tend to hold exacting standards and to master a craft through repetition and care. Duty comes naturally, though forgiving your own mistakes takes practice.
saturn.libra: Your sense of fairness is honored here, and you take commitments seriously. You tend to build relationships and agreements that last, and you carry a clear sense of obligation and balance.
saturn.scorpio: You tend to guard strong feelings with discipline, and trust is given slowly. Endurance is your strength, and you learn to face what others avoid.
saturn.sagittarius: You tend to test beliefs before adopting them, building convictions slowly and keeping them. Doubt is the early companion, and teaching or travel comes later and with substance.
saturn.capricorn: Your sense of structure is at home here, patient, ambitious, and comfortable with responsibility. You tend to build for the long term, and authority comes to you gradually through time.
saturn.aquarius: Your discipline is at home here, serving principles, fair rules, and the common good. You tend to value order that applies to everyone, and you work steadily on slow collective change.
saturn.pisces: You tend to give form to imagination with discipline, and fear of losing yourself can make you cautious. The work is building structures that are firm enough to hold faith and creativity.

uranus.aries: This generation tends to break from precedent through individual action, with sudden starts and a push for personal autonomy.
uranus.taurus: This generation tends to unsettle what counts as secure, shaking up ideas about money, land, food, and the body.
uranus.gemini: This generation tends to rewire how information moves, with new ways of learning, speaking, and connecting.
uranus.cancer: This generation tends to reshape ideas of home, family, and belonging, loosening inherited forms of the household.
uranus.leo: This generation tends to draw attention to new styles of creativity and self-expression, and to unconventional leadership.
uranus.virgo: This generation tends to rework daily labour, health, and method, bringing change to how ordinary tasks are done.
uranus.libra: This generation tends to redefine partnership and fairness, with new expectations of how people relate and share.
uranus.scorpio: This generation tends to bring hidden matters to the surface, changing attitudes about sexuality, shared resources, and taboo.
uranus.sagittarius: This generation tends to loosen inherited belief, with new attitudes toward travel, education, and what counts as truth.
uranus.capricorn: This generation tends to restructure institutions and authority, testing which long-standing forms are still needed.
uranus.aquarius: This generation tends to be at ease with networks, technology, and collective freedom, and with the idea that the future can be designed.
uranus.pisces: This generation tends to dissolve old boundaries, shifting spirituality, imagination, and the line between real and imagined.

neptune.aries: This generation tends to idealise the pioneer, with a shared faith in fresh starts and the courage to begin.
neptune.taurus: This generation tends to hold ideals around land, resources, and beauty, and to find meaning in the tangible.
neptune.gemini: This generation tends to live among stories, rumour, and blurred information, with a gift for imaginative language.
neptune.cancer: This generation tends to idealise home, nation, and family, with a strong pull of nostalgia and protection.
neptune.leo: This generation tends to be touched by glamour, performance, and romance, with creative display as a shared dream.
neptune.virgo: This generation tends to carry ideals about service, health, and purity, and sometimes confusion over practical detail.
neptune.libra: This generation tends to idealise harmony and romance, with a shared hope for peace and beautiful partnership.
neptune.scorpio: This generation tends to be drawn to mystery, the hidden, and the occult, and to hold vague, powerful fears about them.
neptune.sagittarius: This generation tends to hold ideals of faith, quest, and far horizons, with belief that can inspire or mislead.
neptune.capricorn: This generation tends to see institutions and authority through a haze, with ideals that dissolve and rebuild structure.
neptune.aquarius: This generation tends to carry collective ideals about technology, community, and the shared future.
neptune.pisces: This generation tends to feel compassion, mysticism, and art as shared currents, and to be sensitive to the collective mood.

pluto.aries: This generation tends to carry a raw sense of individual power, with transformation arriving through assertion and new beginnings.
pluto.taurus: This generation tends to confront questions of resources, land, and value, with slow, deep changes to what people hold.
pluto.gemini: This generation tends to see power in information and communication, with deep changes in how people talk and learn.
pluto.cancer: This generation tends to feel intense change around home, family, and nation, and strong attachment to belonging.
pluto.leo: This generation tends to be marked by personal power, creative will, and questions about who leads and who is seen.
pluto.virgo: This generation tends to see deep change in work, health, and systems, with scrutiny of how daily life is organised.
pluto.libra: This generation tends to see power reshaped through relationships, law, and the balance between parties.
pluto.scorpio: This generation tends to face taboo directly, with intense attention to sex, death, shared resources, and what is concealed.
pluto.sagittarius: This generation tends to transform belief and ideology, with strong convictions and changing views of the wider world.
pluto.capricorn: This generation tends to see institutions, authority, and the economy tested and rebuilt from the foundations.
pluto.aquarius: This generation tends to see power move into networks and groups, with deep change in technology and collective life.
pluto.pisces: This generation tends to feel the dissolving of old collective forms, and a deep search for faith and shared meaning.
